content: Specific 'incomplete profile -> resume onboarding' routing patterns for dating apps are not well documented publicly (architecture is proprietary), but general pattern from system-design writeups: an API gateway/auth layer routes authenticated requests to a profile service; profile completeness is typically tracked as a status flag/percentage read on each authenticated request to decide whether to route to onboarding vs main app. Incomplete profiles are also down-ranked/hidden from matching until complete per informal industry consensus.
